title: Gen 7.1 · independent standard selfplay and Gen6/BEN anchors
pending: Opens when 71s-32~7s-32 has at least 1,000 boards over all collectors and 7.1 is ahead with the lower end of a 95% interval above zero (Max, 12 November 2026, 05:42 UTC). Whoever opens it records the count and the interval in the notice.
notes: Authorized by Max, 12 November 2026, 05:42 UTC: "Pull the 4.1 policy net and prepare to upgrade the bots with them effective 6AM unless testing tells otherwise. Replace the 7.0 self play with 7.0/7.1 matches for at least 1000 boards / until 7.1 establishes a 95% CI lead, then switch to 7.1 self play. All other matches should replace 7 with 7.1. All of this is effective 6:00 unless revoked." It applies to the arena's collectors, not to Gen 8 research. docs/gen71_2026-11-12.md is the notice this file belongs to.

Gen 7.1 standard (71s-32) is Gen 7 standard (7s-32) with policy net v4.1 in place of v4 and nothing else changed: the same Gen 6 base bot (6-32), the same gen7 settings, the same tree. v4.1 has v4's shape, inputs and hand-fit scorer and was trained on every board on the feeds at 03:59 UTC on 12 November.

What configs/round71-compare.json becomes once 7.1 has established its lead: 71s-32 against itself in place of 71s-32 against 7s-32. A self-play board is one table, supplies training data and has no IMP comparison; its records carry null scores, never zeros.

Audit and capture settings (tie audits, gap forks, room seeds) are carried over from the source run, not set here. Prepare at the commit named in the notice or later: earlier sources ignore the gap_fork setting, and before this branch a plan could name only one policy release.

Source run. A machine prepares from the drained cohort it is replacing (STOP and WATCHDOG_STOP in place, its feed complete), so the deals that cohort had not played are the ones used; the cohort it replaces is then finished for good. A machine starting fresh prepares from the capture capsule with its own --shard K/N.
model_note: Gen 7.1 standard (71s-32) is Gen 7 standard with policy net v4.1 in place of v4; nothing else differs. Gen 7 standard (7s-32) is Gen 6 fast (6-32: same bidder, lead net, hand-fit scorer, layouts and 32 samples) with the gen7 engine (bridge_harness/gen7.py) and policy net v4: layouts weighted by the play so far from trick 7, exact ties broken by the net, and at tricks 3 to 6 a tree search over the net's likeliest cards that re-values the cards the search rates within 0.25 tricks of its best (trust 0.3, stake rule at 0.5 IMPs, at most 3 tricks, 8 layouts). Settings are in the bot's `gen7` block. Every other bot is unchanged from the source run. docs/gen7_alpha_2026-11-11.md has the details.
interpretation: Gen 7.1 standard self-play supplies training data only, one table a deal, with no IMP comparison and no strength estimate; Gen 7.1 against Gen 6 fast remains the generation comparison, with common and native auctions as separate conditions. Only unplayed source deals are allocated. Intervals are descriptive and unadjusted for repeated monitoring.
